title: Settings
description: Customize the interface, reading experience, and AI lookup without mixing learning preferences with account settings.

learningBehavior.title: Learning behavior
learningBehavior.description: App-wide learning preferences live here; reading-specific options stay in the Reading section.
learningBehavior.globalLookupDescription: Applies across learning pages, vocabulary, and the dashboard; Notes has its own scope below.
learningBehavior.notesLookupDescription: Keeps a separate preference for Notes without affecting other learning pages.
learningBehavior.focusModeDescription: Locks route and lesson changes until you turn it off from Gear or this page.
learningBehavior.focusModeEnabled: Focus mode is on. You will stay in the current lesson and can only change the current section or open note tab.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light and dark mode define the base surfaces. Palettes add stronger canvas accents, lighter Card accents, and a consistent color for primary, focus, and selected states while popovers, inputs, and borders remain neutral for readability.
appearance.modeDescription: System automatically follows the operating system appearance.
appearance.paletteDescription: Changes page and Card surfaces plus primary, selected, and active-navigation colors as one palette.

editorial.label: Hanzi Studio Indigo
editorial.description: Cool indigo, bright paper surfaces, and editorial study-workspace accents.

jade.label: Jade
jade.description: Balanced green with calm canvas and Card surfaces plus clear active states.

warm.label: Warm Sepia
warm.description: A restrained sepia palette for long reading sessions while preserving hierarchy.

plum.label: Plum
plum.description: Soft plum on canvas and Cards with clear active states without tinting popovers or inputs.

mono.label: Black & White
mono.description: Neutral contrast with almost all decorative color removed.

tea.label: Green Tea
tea.description: Low-saturation tea green with calm canvas and Card surfaces for extended study.

ai.title: AI lookup settings
ai.description: Quick lookup prioritizes lesson and dictionary data. Lightweight AI runs only when cache misses; stronger models run only when you explicitly open details.
ai.detailDescription: Used only for deeper analysis, examples, character structure, or grammar. If no personal key is configured, the app uses the system Gemini model selected below.
ai.legacyModel: A legacy model is still stored. Choose a current model to update it.
ai.quickDescription: Flow: lesson vocabulary → shared dictionary → legacy cache → lightweight AI. No personal API key is required.
ai.quickModelDescription: Optimized for low-latency meanings and short Sino-Vietnamese readings.
ai.localFallback: Using AI prompt settings stored locally in this browser
ai.savedLocal: AI prompt settings saved in this browser

prompts.title: Lookup Prompts
prompts.description: Advanced prompts are used only for detailed analysis. Quick lookup keeps a short fixed prompt to reduce latency and token usage.
prompts.wordDescription: Used for words and short phrases. Keep the {token} placeholder so the backend can inject the lookup term.
prompts.sentenceDescription: Used for sentences and passages. Keep the {token} placeholder so the backend can inject the actual content.

apiKeys.title: Personal API keys for detailed analysis
apiKeys.description: Every model in this section requires a personal API key. Providers may offer free quota, but the app still needs a key to call their API. Failed requests never trigger automatic key or model switching.
apiKeys.dialogDescription: Choose a provider and model, then enter the matching key.
apiKeys.guideStep1: Choose Groq or Gemini to start with a free tier, or another provider if you already have a paid account.
apiKeys.guideStep2: Open the key page, sign in to the provider, then create and copy a new API key.
apiKeys.guideStep3: Return here, paste the key, and choose Verify and save. The app checks it with the provider before encrypting and storing it.
apiKeys.quotaDisclaimer: Free tiers, pricing, and quotas are controlled by each provider and can change. The app validates the key only; use the provider pricing/limits page for authoritative account limits.
apiKeys.freeGuideDescription: Groq and Gemini currently document free tiers. You still create your own personal key; the app never embeds or shares a public key.
apiKeys.statsScope: These are configuration and validation stats, not token or cost usage. Historical usage inside the app requires a backend usage-storage contract.
apiKeys.schemaNotReady: The database is not ready for user_api_keys. Apply or repair the migration, then reload this page.
apiKeys.summary: {total} keys · {active} enabled · used only for detailed analysis
apiKeys.loadErrorDescription: Check the connection and try again. Existing key data has not been changed.
apiKeys.emptyReady: Quick lookup still uses the system model. Add a key only when you want a personal model for detailed analysis.
apiKeys.emptyNotReady: Apply the database migration first, then return here to add a key.
apiKeys.deleteDescription: The key will be removed from your app account and cannot be used for new requests. This does not revoke the original key at the provider.
apiKeys.pasted: API key pasted from the clipboard.
apiKeys.addError: Unable to add the API key.
apiKeys.toggleError: Unable to update the key status.
apiKeys.moveError: Unable to change the key order.

providers.groq: High-speed detailed word and sentence analysis through Groq BYOK.
providers.deepseek: Uses the selected DeepSeek model for lookup and analysis.
providers.gemini: Uses Google AI Studio / Gemini API.
providers.openai: Uses the selected OpenAI model for lookup and analysis.

models.gptOss20b: Fast for short lookups; available on Groq Free Plan quota.
models.gptOss120b: Higher quality; available on Groq Free Plan quota.
models.qwen36: Well suited to Chinese content; available on Groq Free Plan quota.
models.deepseekFlash: Newer model optimized for speed and frequent lookup.
models.deepseekPro: Newer model for tasks that need higher quality.
models.gemini35Flash: Stable model for longer and more complex tasks.
models.gemini31Pro: Preview model for tasks that need stronger reasoning.
models.gemini25Flash: Balanced default for speed and quality.
models.gemini25Pro: Stronger model that may respond more slowly.
models.gpt5Mini: Fast and suitable for structured lookup.
models.gpt41Mini: Stable model for JSON and instruction following.
models.legacy: This model was saved by an older version. Choose a current model to update it.
